comment: Neural output ABI for ntc_encoder_heads_v1. Class orderings are FROZEN for this version: changing any list requires a head_spec_version bump. Output tensor names are what Backend::run returns and what the PyTorch reference dumps for parity fixtures. Shapes use T=max_tools(+1 for NO_TOOL where noted), A=max_args, E=max_enum_values, Lu=max_utterance_tokens.

inputs.packing: See docs/model-format.md §input-packing: utterance encoded with tokenizer specials; each candidate tool's canonical ABI text encoded independently; arg/enum anchor positions are the first token whose offset covers the arg name / enum value in the canonical text; NO_TOOL is a learned pseudo-tool appended after the T candidates in fusion.

action.decode: argmax; softmax with calibration temperature -> action_confidence

tool.classes: candidate index 0..T-1 in request candidate order; index T = NO_TOOL
tool.decode: argmax over the first n_candidates entries plus NO_TOOL; padded candidate slots are masked to -inf by the runtime before softmax; NO_TOOL argmax downgrades CALL to NO_CALL

presence.decode: argmax per declared arg of the selected tool; padded arg slots ignored; MISSING/AMBIGUOUS on a required arg emits an unresolved entry (reason MISSING/AMBIGUOUS)

boolean.decode: argmax; consulted only for BOOLEAN-typed args with presence PRESENT

span.decode: start = argmax(start.logits); end = argmax over end.logits[start..start+MAX_SPAN) then +1 (end exclusive, end > start); MAX_SPAN = 32 tokens; padded utterance positions masked to -inf; consulted for TEXT/PERSON/LOCATION values and as the surface source for INTEGER/FLOAT/DATE/DATETIME deterministic parsing

enum.decode: argmax over the first n_enum_values entries of the bound arg (runtime masks the rest); index points into CanonicalArg.enum_values order

numeric.decode: magnitude is predicted in asinh space: value = sinh(x). Primary numeric value comes from deterministic parsing of the span text; the regression is the fallback and consistency signal

datetime.decode: relation ABSOLUTE -> parse the span text deterministically; relation IN/AGO take magnitude/unit from the numeric head; factored fields with class NONE are omitted from the IR value

pooling.user: utterance encoder state at token 0 (tokenizer BOS/CLS)
pooling.global: fusion state of the NO_TOOL pseudo-tool
pooling.tool_state: fusion state at each tool's first schema token (the `TOOL` keyword token)
pooling.arg_state: fusion state at the arg-name anchor token
pooling.enum_state: fusion state at the enum-value anchor token

confidence.method: per-head temperature scaling; temperatures stored in .ntc metadata under model.calibration; default 1.0
